sections.description: Tour Manager Theme is designed for travel and booking-related websites with a clean layout and organized content structure. The theme includes sections for tour packages, destination details, itineraries, booking forms, testimonials, and contact information. It supports responsive layouts to improve usability across desktops, tablets, and mobile devices. The theme provides customizable banner areas, typography settings, color controls, and widget-ready sections for flexible page arrangement. It is compatible with common page builder plugins and supports image galleries, blog layouts, and social media integration. The code structure follows standard development practices to support performance and easier customization. Additional features include breadcrumb navigation, SEO-friendly structure, translation readiness, and integration with contact forms. The homepage layout can be adjusted using built-in customization options without modifying core files. The theme also supports multiple menu locations and footer widget areas for better site organization. Its layout focuses on presenting travel-related information in a structured and accessible format while maintaining consistent visual styling throughout the website.
